units: <cite ref="Zevachim 85a:11">Zeb. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>יפשיט וִינַתֵּחַ וכ׳</he> he must flay and dissect it in its place (where he slaughtered it).
<cite ref="Chullin 28b:3">Ḥull. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון שמְנַתְּחָהּ אבר אבר</he> (not <he>דמנ׳</he>) since he cuts it into parts; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to distrain, take by force, esp. to seize by waiting for the debtor to come out of the house with an object, opp. to מִשְׁכֵּן, to enter and seize.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 113a:8">B. Mets. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>אימא לא יְנַתְּחֶנּוּ וכ׳</he> read in the Mishnah (<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:13">B. Mets. IX, 13</cite>), he must not seize his goods outside of his house except through the court messenger.
